messages:
jen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — the auth-provider + model-registry outage on 2026-03-18. I captured the action items; want to lock owners and short timelines here.

sam: thanks jen. can we call out the recurrence pattern? this isnt the first time token refreshes tripped the registry proxy.

anita: yep — saw a 3x spike in token churn around 02:14 UTC which correlated with 502s to model-registry. looks like race on refresh + retry storm.

leo: also saw a simultaneous GCP control-plane network flap in us-central1 at ~02:10 per provider status — probably amplified the retries.

jen: summary: root cause = auth provider token refresh race that caused retries → overloaded registry proxy; exacerbated by short-lived control-plane network instability.

marcus: action 1: add circuit breaker in registry-proxy to reject excessive refreshes and return 429 before queueing. owner: marcus. eta: 1 week (2026-03-25).

anita: action 2: add idempotent refresh dedupe in auth client library (global token cache w/ single inflight refresh). owner: anita. eta: 2 weeks (2026-04-01).

sam: action 3: vendor escalation with auth-provider to get root-cause + improved SLA around token endpoint availability. owner: sam. eta: 3 business days (request already opened, ref AUTH-720).

leo: action 4: model-registry mirror of active model blobs to S3 in a separate region so serving can fall back to local artifact store if registry is unreachable. owner: leo. eta: 3 weeks (2026-04-08).

jen: action 5: add synthetic canary that exercises token refresh + registry fetch at 1m cadence per region; alert on >2 failures in 5m. owner: opsbot. eta: 4 days (2026-03-22).

opsbot: note: synthetic canary rule created: `canary.auth-registry-refresh` — will post in #eng-oncall and /pager after threshold.

marcus: action 6: throttle edge retries from SDKs for 5xx/502 to exponential backoff + jitter with max attempts 4. owner: marcus. eta: 1 week.

anita: also propose a weekly recurring incident review for third-party auth/regional provider blips — identify patterns. owner: anita. recurrence: weekly starting 2026-03-24.

sam: recommend contractual ask: 99.99% token endpoint availability + incident notification SLA. i'll draft the request.

jen: for tracking: I'll put these into the postmortem follow-up ticket and assign. short checklist we can update: owners, exact PRs, rollout windows, rollback plans.

leo: small implementation note — when we mirror registry blobs, make sure signatures and checksum validation still run; we can't compromise integrity.

marcus: agree. also add an automatic circuit-breaker override for paid Dedicated customers to prefer cached artifacts over registry when enabled. owner: product (cc: jen). eta: 2 weeks.

anita: testing plan: simulate token storm with tooling: `scripts/simulate-token-refresh -concurrency 500 -duration 10m` and verify circuit breaker trips and system degrades gracefully. I'll add tests to the repo.

jen: final ask: everyone please drop PR links in this thread when ready and update the follow-up ticket. we'll re-check in next Monday ops sync. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sam: noted — thanks all.

opsbot: Incident bot: follow-up ticket INF-1839 created and linked to postmortem.
